what: fax: Facts About the Host, Container and Runtime — fax-package
title: fax: Facts About the Host, Container and Runtime — fax-package
text: Reports facts operating system, hardware, virtualization, containers, 'Kubernetes' pods, 'Azure', 'R' 'Python' runtimes. Reports CPU memory current process can actually use 'cgroup' limits CPU affinity, side side host values, thread pools memory budgets can sized correctly inside containers. Also lists installed system, 'R' 'Python' packages, provides cheap CPU memory usage probe log messages. Pure 'R', network access unless explicitly requested.

title: Current CPU and memory usage, cheap enough for every log line — usage
text: usage() reads process's container's current CPU memory use. skips fact engine: everything static (cgroup paths, limits, page size) worked per session, call reads small files Linux. usage_line() formats result compact string log messages.

text: extra Additional, slightly expensive fields: "host" adds mem_host_available "working_set" adds mem_working_set. max_age Return previous result many seconds old, hot loops. ... Passed usage().

title: Current CPU and memory usage, cheap enough for every log line — usage
text: usage(): named numeric vector class fax_usage time: sample taken, seconds since epoch. cpu_process: CPU cores used R process since previous call. cpu_cgroup: CPU cores used whole container since previous call, including processes parallel workers. cpu_throttled: share CPU scheduling periods since previous call container throttled hitting CPU quota. cpu_limit: CPU cores process may use (see effective_cores()). mem_rss: resident memory process, bytes. mem_cgroup: memory used container, including page cache. mem_limit: memory limit (see effective_memory()). mem_pct: mem_cgroup / mem_limit, mem_rss share host memory container. usage_line(): string "cpu=1.8/4 thr=3% mem=2.1G/8G(26%) rss=1.2G".

title: Current CPU and memory usage, cheap enough for every log line — usage
text: CPU values rates, compare previous call: first call reports process's average since started, cpu_cgroup cpu_throttled NA second call. fork() (e.g. parallel::mclapply() workers) baseline starts . macOS Windows, mem_rss needs ps package, container fields always NA.

title: fax (development version)
text: Initial CRAN submission. effective_cores() effective_memory() return CPU cores memory process can actually use, taking cgroup v1/v2 limits, cpusets CPU affinity account. facts(), fact() facts_df() provide lazy, cached snapshot facts per-fact status source. Resolver errors never escape unless strict = TRUE. Linux cgroup, cpu memory facts available. usage() usage_line() report current process container CPU memory use cheaply enough call every log line.
